facts.fact: The DGSSI says its Director General, Abdellah Boutrig, is Vice-President of the African Network of Cybersecurity Authorities (ANCA).
Morocco's CNDP took part in the work of the African Network of Data Protection Authorities (NADPA-RAPDP), of which Morocco holds the permanent secretariat, at a meeting reported on 18 November 2026.

The first meeting of the new executive bureau of the African Network of Data Protection Authorities (NADPA-RAPDP) was held in Rabat in September 2026, with Morocco holding the network's permanent secretariat.
Morocco's CNDP signed an agreement with Cabo Verde's data protection commission, CNPD, committing both to cooperate on personal data protection, with CNDP to train CNPD staff.

note: The only agreement is with Portugal, outside Africa; the African data protection network RAPDP is named only as a network the CNDP has relations with, not as membership.
